verdicts.reasoning: Every seed prompt directs the user to sort a series of fractions, using explicit phrasings like "Order these fractions", "Arrange these fractions", or "Which list shows these fractions ordered".

All sets of fractions provided in these seeds share common denominators within their respective sets (e.g., 7/8, 6/8, 4/8, 5/8 in seed 11 and 1/6, 5/6, 3/6, 2/6 in seed 23), cleanly exhibiting similar fractions.
These seeds specifically require ordering fractions in increasing order. Seeds 11, 42, 64, 78, 103, and 118 use "smallest to largest", while seed 127 uses the equivalent "least to greatest".
The 'vice versa' clause tests decreasing order. Seeds 23 and 57 ask to order from "largest to smallest", and seed 91 asks for "greatest to least", successfully showing this alternative direction.
